notes: Periods now actually show up in the story. When someone with you is on her period or PMSing, the narrator gets a reminder on that very turn to show it through a small in-character detail (cramps, a hand on her stomach, a restroom trip for a pad or tampon, a hot water bottle, cravings, a shorter temper), picked differently each time. It comes up most on the heaviest days and stays consistent in between instead of vanishing.
